meta.title: Wedge of Mass
meta.description: The shortfall of mass will be made up for with life.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, inside the OAS-1702.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, inside the OAS-1702.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, inside the OAS-1702.

units.rawText: The entropic attack... it's stopped.
units.displayText: The entropic attack... it's stopped.

spans.text: The entropic attack... it's stopped.

units.rawText: Hubble, did Xinghuan...
units.displayText: Hubble, did Xinghuan...

spans.text: Hubble, did Xinghuan...

units.rawText: Now, Fresnel! We need to complete the changeover right away!
units.displayText: Now, Fresnel! We need to complete the changeover right away!

spans.text: Now, Fresnel! We need to complete the changeover right away!

units.rawText: Hubble bites back her grief and enters the final lines of the decryption program into the control terminal.
units.displayText: Hubble bites back her grief and enters the final lines of the decryption program into the control terminal.

spans.text: Hubble bites back her grief and enters the final lines of the decryption program into the control terminal.

units.rawText: ...Decryption successful, Hubble! Hold on tight!
units.displayText: ...Decryption successful, Hubble! Hold on tight!

spans.text: ...Decryption successful, Hubble! Hold on tight!

units.rawText: Fresnel takes the helm of the spaceship and throws it into a tight turn to lose the pursuing entropics behind her. Then, she changes direction again and heads for the space elevator.
units.displayText: Fresnel takes the helm of the spaceship and throws it into a tight turn to lose the pursuing entropics behind her. Then, she changes direction again and heads for the space elevator.

spans.text: Fresnel takes the helm of the spaceship and throws it into a tight turn to lose the pursuing entropics behind her. Then, she changes direction again and heads for the space elevator.

units.rawText: Verifying craft model, searching database... Identity confirmed. Welcome to Jiutian's Gabon Experimental Base's space elevator...
units.displayText: Verifying craft model, searching database... Identity confirmed. Welcome to Jiutian's Gabon Experimental Base's space elevator...

spans.text: Verifying craft model, searching database... Identity confirmed. Welcome to Jiutian's Gabon Experimental Base's space elevator...

units.rawText: The top deck on the space elevator opens, allowing the ship to enter...
units.displayText: The top deck on the space elevator opens, allowing the ship to enter...

spans.text: The top deck on the space elevator opens, allowing the ship to enter...

units.rawText: The dawn breaks! We did it, Fresnel... We did it!
units.displayText: The dawn breaks! We did it, Fresnel... We did it!

spans.text: The dawn breaks! We did it, Fresnel... We did it!

units.rawText: At such a high cost... we finally...
units.displayText: At such a high cost... we finally...

spans.text: At such a high cost... we finally...

units.rawText: Fresnel exhales heavily, as though a great weight has been lifted from her shoulders, and then she collapses into her chair, quietly watching as the space elevator draws their ship into its embrace.
units.displayText: Fresnel exhales heavily, as though a great weight has been lifted from her shoulders, and then she collapses into her chair, quietly watching as the space elevator draws their ship into its embrace.

spans.text: Fresnel exhales heavily, as though a great weight has been lifted from her shoulders, and then she collapses into her chair, quietly watching as the space elevator draws their ship into its embrace.

units.rawText: Engaging space elevator thermal insulation layer...
units.displayText: Engaging space elevator thermal insulation layer...

spans.text: Engaging space elevator thermal insulation layer...

units.rawText: The sector's data terminal is inside Gabon Base. Thanks to the atmosphere protecting it, the Earth should not have been entropized yet.
units.displayText: The sector's data terminal is inside Gabon Base. Thanks to the atmosphere protecting it, the Earth should not have been entropized yet.

spans.text: The sector's data terminal is inside Gabon Base. Thanks to the atmosphere protecting it, the Earth should not have been entropized yet.

units.rawText: Once we reach Gabon Base, we'll be able to reset the sector and these agents will also be able to...
units.displayText: Once we reach Gabon Base, we'll be able to reset the sector and these agents will also be able to...

spans.text: Once we reach Gabon Base, we'll be able to reset the sector and these agents will also be able to...

units.rawText: The lift will now be entering the atmosphere. Please brace for possible turbulence...
units.displayText: The lift will now be entering the atmosphere. Please brace for possible turbulence...

spans.text: The lift will now be entering the atmosphere. Please brace for possible turbulence...

units.rawText: Thunk!
units.displayText: Thunk!

spans.text: Thunk!

units.rawText: The elevator suddenly plummets and the car tilts to one side, sending Hubble sliding to the other side of the vessel.
units.displayText: The elevator suddenly plummets and the car tilts to one side, sending Hubble sliding to the other side of the vessel.

spans.text: The elevator suddenly plummets and the car tilts to one side, sending Hubble sliding to the other side of the vessel.

units.rawText: What happened? Are the gravity ripples THAT big?
units.displayText: What happened? Are the gravity ripples THAT big?

spans.text: What happened? Are the gravity ripples THAT big?

units.rawText: Hubble, you should put on your space suit...
units.displayText: Hubble, you should put on your space suit...

spans.text: Hubble, you should put on your space suit...

units.rawText: As the vessel shakes, Hubble struggles to her feet and lifts her head before accepting the space suit that Fresnel is handing her. Through the observation windows, they can both see that part of the space elevator's armored superstructure is starting to turn purple from entropization...
units.displayText: As the vessel shakes, Hubble struggles to her feet and lifts her head before accepting the space suit that Fresnel is handing her. Through the observation windows, they can both see that part of the space elevator's armored superstructure is starting to turn purple from entropization...

spans.text: As the vessel shakes, Hubble struggles to her feet and lifts her head before accepting the space suit that Fresnel is handing her. Through the observation windows, they can both see that part of the space elevator's armored superstructure is starting to turn purple from entropization...

units.rawText: Fresnel! Look outside!!
units.displayText: Fresnel! Look outside!!

spans.text: Fresnel! Look outside!!

units.rawText: Fresnel does as she is told and sees that the space elevator's white exterior has become overgrown with a network of purple veins at some point, and entropics are crawling into the elevator shaft through a breach.
units.displayText: Fresnel does as she is told and sees that the space elevator's white exterior has become overgrown with a network of purple veins at some point, and entropics are crawling into the elevator shaft through a breach.

spans.text: Fresnel does as she is told and sees that the space elevator's white exterior has become overgrown with a network of purple veins at some point, and entropics are crawling into the elevator shaft through a breach.

units.rawText: When did they entropize the space elevator...
units.displayText: When did they entropize the space elevator...

spans.text: When did they entropize the space elevator...

units.rawText: They were probably on the elevator while we were trying to transfer the ship to it...
units.displayText: They were probably on the elevator while we were trying to transfer the ship to it...

spans.text: They were probably on the elevator while we were trying to transfer the ship to it...

units.rawText: If we stay inside the elevator car, the ship will get entropized quickly... and... ahhhh!!!!
units.displayText: If we stay inside the elevator car, the ship will get entropized quickly... and... ahhhh!!!!

spans.text: If we stay inside the elevator car, the ship will get entropized quickly... and... ahhhh!!!!

units.rawText: Another shockwave rocks the vessel! As the spaceship enters the atmosphere, the sound of the collapsing elevator explodes in their ears like thunder.
units.displayText: Another shockwave rocks the vessel! As the spaceship enters the atmosphere, the sound of the collapsing elevator explodes in their ears like thunder.

spans.text: Another shockwave rocks the vessel! As the spaceship enters the atmosphere, the sound of the collapsing elevator explodes in their ears like thunder.

units.rawText: Warning— vessel descent speed exceeds safe velocities...
units.displayText: Warning— vessel descent speed exceeds safe velocities...

spans.text: Warning— vessel descent speed exceeds safe velocities...

units.rawText: We need to get out of here right now! Otherwise we'll be picking between being entropized or being smashed to bits.
units.displayText: We need to get out of here right now! Otherwise we'll be picking between being entropized or being smashed to bits.

spans.text: We need to get out of here right now! Otherwise we'll be picking between being entropized or being smashed to bits.

units.rawText: The elevator superstructure is too thick, we can't burst our way through it.
units.displayText: The elevator superstructure is too thick, we can't burst our way through it.

spans.text: The elevator superstructure is too thick, we can't burst our way through it.

units.rawText: Then we'll shoot our way out!!! Hellbore Cannon, bearing 12 o'clock, FIRE!!
units.displayText: Then we'll shoot our way out!!! Hellbore Cannon, bearing 12 o'clock, FIRE!!

spans.text: Then we'll shoot our way out!!! Hellbore Cannon, bearing 12 o'clock, FIRE!!

units.rawText: <size=40>Boom!!</size>
units.displayText: Boom!!

spans.text: Boom!!

units.rawText: The cannon blasts a huge hole in the armored elevator shaft, and Fresnel pilots the ship out of it in an emergency escape. The vessel's high-speed descent and the massive amount of heat caused by atmospheric friction make the cabin temperature spike.
units.displayText: The cannon blasts a huge hole in the armored elevator shaft, and Fresnel pilots the ship out of it in an emergency escape. The vessel's high-speed descent and the massive amount of heat caused by atmospheric friction make the cabin temperature spike.

spans.text: The cannon blasts a huge hole in the armored elevator shaft, and Fresnel pilots the ship out of it in an emergency escape. The vessel's high-speed descent and the massive amount of heat caused by atmospheric friction make the cabin temperature spike.

units.rawText: Warning— Cabin temperature exceeds safe levels...
units.displayText: Warning— Cabin temperature exceeds safe levels...

spans.text: Warning— Cabin temperature exceeds safe levels...

units.rawText: Activate heat shields!
units.displayText: Activate heat shields!

spans.text: Activate heat shields!

units.rawText: Stand by retrorockets, execute forced descent procedure... all astern full!
units.displayText: Stand by retrorockets, execute forced descent procedure... all astern full!

spans.text: Stand by retrorockets, execute forced descent procedure... all astern full!

units.rawText: Fresnel keeps her eyes fixed on the command terminal.
units.displayText: Fresnel keeps her eyes fixed on the command terminal.

spans.text: Fresnel keeps her eyes fixed on the command terminal.

units.rawText: Switch system to autopilot; destination Gabon Data Center!
units.displayText: Switch system to autopilot; destination Gabon Data Center!

spans.text: Switch system to autopilot; destination Gabon Data Center!

units.rawText: Violent shaking accompanies the ear-piercing screech of grinding metal and the unbearable weight of excessive gravity.
units.displayText: Violent shaking accompanies the ear-piercing screech of grinding metal and the unbearable weight of excessive gravity.

spans.text: Violent shaking accompanies the ear-piercing screech of grinding metal and the unbearable weight of excessive gravity.

units.rawText: The emergency heat shielding saves the ship, and Hubble can glimpse the space elevator tilting and keeling over...
units.displayText: The emergency heat shielding saves the ship, and Hubble can glimpse the space elevator tilting and keeling over...

spans.text: The emergency heat shielding saves the ship, and Hubble can glimpse the space elevator tilting and keeling over...

units.rawText: The cables snap and the elevator car plunges downward at an angle. The sight of the purple entropization where the cables snapped makes Hubble gasp in shock.
units.displayText: The cables snap and the elevator car plunges downward at an angle. The sight of the purple entropization where the cables snapped makes Hubble gasp in shock.

spans.text: The cables snap and the elevator car plunges downward at an angle. The sight of the purple entropization where the cables snapped makes Hubble gasp in shock.

units.rawText: Warning— Gravity parameters irregular, vessel has lost balance...
units.displayText: Warning— Gravity parameters irregular, vessel has lost balance...

spans.text: Warning— Gravity parameters irregular, vessel has lost balance...

units.rawText:
Kaboom!
The space elevator collapses and is reduced to a pile of rubble in the blink of an eye.
units.displayText:
Kaboom!
The space elevator collapses and is reduced to a pile of rubble in the blink of an eye.

spans.text:
Kaboom!
The space elevator collapses and is reduced to a pile of rubble in the blink of an eye.

units.rawText: The impact is so great that it even deforms the interior of the spaceship.
units.displayText: The impact is so great that it even deforms the interior of the spaceship.

spans.text: The impact is so great that it even deforms the interior of the spaceship.

units.rawText: ...Ugh... This is bad...
units.displayText: ...Ugh... This is bad...

spans.text: ...Ugh... This is bad...

units.rawText: <size=40>Hubble!</size>
units.displayText: Hubble!

spans.text: Hubble!

units.rawText: Hubble is thrown into mid-air and the combination of the impact and the massive neural cloud strain blacks her vision out.
units.displayText: Hubble is thrown into mid-air and the combination of the impact and the massive neural cloud strain blacks her vision out.

spans.text: Hubble is thrown into mid-air and the combination of the impact and the massive neural cloud strain blacks her vision out.

units.rawText: At the last moment before everything goes dark, Hubble sees Fresnel undoing her safety belt and rushing toward her...
units.displayText: At the last moment before everything goes dark, Hubble sees Fresnel undoing her safety belt and rushing toward her...

spans.text: At the last moment before everything goes dark, Hubble sees Fresnel undoing her safety belt and rushing toward her...

units.rawText: Owie... that hurt...
units.displayText: Owie... that hurt...

spans.text: Owie... that hurt...

units.rawText: Hubble slowly climbs to her feet and rubs her head.
units.displayText: Hubble slowly climbs to her feet and rubs her head.

spans.text: Hubble slowly climbs to her feet and rubs her head.

units.rawText: Huh? This is an anti-overload helmet... did Fresnel put it on for me?
units.displayText: Huh? This is an anti-overload helmet... did Fresnel put it on for me?

spans.text: Huh? This is an anti-overload helmet... did Fresnel put it on for me?

units.rawText: Fresnel?!
units.displayText: Fresnel?!

spans.text: Fresnel?!

units.rawText: Hubble frantically looks around and finally sees Fresnel passed out in the corner.
units.displayText: Hubble frantically looks around and finally sees Fresnel passed out in the corner.

spans.text: Hubble frantically looks around and finally sees Fresnel passed out in the corner.

units.rawText: She struggles to her feet and then heads over to Fresnel's side.
units.displayText: She struggles to her feet and then heads over to Fresnel's side.

spans.text: She struggles to her feet and then heads over to Fresnel's side.

units.rawText: Fresnel? Fresnel?
units.displayText: Fresnel? Fresnel?

spans.text: Fresnel? Fresnel?

units.rawText: How long has it been since we crashed? How's Jupiter doing... as well as the other...
units.displayText: How long has it been since we crashed? How's Jupiter doing... as well as the other...

spans.text: How long has it been since we crashed? How's Jupiter doing... as well as the other...

units.rawText: Hubble takes out her personal terminal and finds a message from the Oasis there.
units.displayText: Hubble takes out her personal terminal and finds a message from the Oasis there.

spans.text: Hubble takes out her personal terminal and finds a message from the Oasis there.

units.rawText: It's from Anna... Ah... she finally finished analyzing it, I see...
units.displayText: It's from Anna... Ah... she finally finished analyzing it, I see...

spans.text: It's from Anna... Ah... she finally finished analyzing it, I see...

units.rawText: This part of the message is about the use of the cipher key and things of note...
units.displayText: This part of the message is about the use of the cipher key and things of note...

spans.text: This part of the message is about the use of the cipher key and things of note...

units.rawText: In other words...
units.displayText: In other words...

spans.text: In other words...

units.rawText: As she looks at the news inside the terminal Hubble gradually balls her hands up into fists.
units.displayText: As she looks at the news inside the terminal Hubble gradually balls her hands up into fists.

spans.text: As she looks at the news inside the terminal Hubble gradually balls her hands up into fists.

units.rawText: Hubble...
units.displayText: Hubble...

spans.text: Hubble...

units.rawText: Fresnel? Are you awake?
units.displayText: Fresnel? Are you awake?

spans.text: Fresnel? Are you awake?

units.rawText: Ah... My head hurts and I think my legs are malfunctioning. This place... where IS this place?
units.displayText: Ah... My head hurts and I think my legs are malfunctioning. This place... where IS this place?

spans.text: Ah... My head hurts and I think my legs are malfunctioning. This place... where IS this place?

units.rawText: This is the data center of Gabon Research Lab... We made it...
units.displayText: This is the data center of Gabon Research Lab... We made it...

spans.text: This is the data center of Gabon Research Lab... We made it...

units.rawText: Fresnel looks at Hubble. For some reason, she seems a little unrecognizable.
units.displayText: Fresnel looks at Hubble. For some reason, she seems a little unrecognizable.

spans.text: Fresnel looks at Hubble. For some reason, she seems a little unrecognizable.

units.rawText: Was I out for long?
units.displayText: Was I out for long?

spans.text: Was I out for long?

units.rawText: Just a while. I woke you up with the medical supplies left in the base. We don't have much time left.
units.displayText: Just a while. I woke you up with the medical supplies left in the base. We don't have much time left.

spans.text: Just a while. I woke you up with the medical supplies left in the base. We don't have much time left.

units.rawText: My guess is... apart from Earth... the rest of the Solar System seems to have been completely entropized.
units.displayText: My guess is... apart from Earth... the rest of the Solar System seems to have been completely entropized.

spans.text: My guess is... apart from Earth... the rest of the Solar System seems to have been completely entropized.

units.rawText: How could this... The Ringworld... Xinghuan... Yuwang...
units.displayText: How could this... The Ringworld... Xinghuan... Yuwang...

spans.text: How could this... The Ringworld... Xinghuan... Yuwang...

units.rawText: Don't tell me... We didn't manage to protect anything at all...
units.displayText: Don't tell me... We didn't manage to protect anything at all...

spans.text: Don't tell me... We didn't manage to protect anything at all...

units.rawText: No. In the darkest hour, hope springs eternal.
units.displayText: No. In the darkest hour, hope springs eternal.

spans.text: No. In the darkest hour, hope springs eternal.

units.rawText: As long as we can restart the Jiutian sector before the Sun swallows the Earth, we can save everything.
units.displayText: As long as we can restart the Jiutian sector before the Sun swallows the Earth, we can save everything.

spans.text: As long as we can restart the Jiutian sector before the Sun swallows the Earth, we can save everything.

units.rawText: The Heat Death is the end of the universe, and also its beginning. Did you forget? It's just like what we went through during that simulated flight in the Oasis.
units.displayText: The Heat Death is the end of the universe, and also its beginning. Did you forget? It's just like what we went through during that simulated flight in the Oasis.

spans.text: The Heat Death is the end of the universe, and also its beginning. Did you forget? It's just like what we went through during that simulated flight in the Oasis.

units.rawText: ...So the end of the Heat Death is the rebirth of the universe...
units.displayText: ...So the end of the Heat Death is the rebirth of the universe...

spans.text: ...So the end of the Heat Death is the rebirth of the universe...

units.rawText: Come, let's go restart the Jiutian sector now.
units.displayText: Come, let's go restart the Jiutian sector now.

spans.text: Come, let's go restart the Jiutian sector now.

units.rawText: Fresnel takes Hubble's hand and rises to her feet, then looks around. There is a terminal in the center of the room, with a progress bar on it.
units.displayText: Fresnel takes Hubble's hand and rises to her feet, then looks around. There is a terminal in the center of the room, with a progress bar on it.

spans.text: Fresnel takes Hubble's hand and rises to her feet, then looks around. There is a terminal in the center of the room, with a progress bar on it.

units.rawText: It's filling up... what is this progress bar...
units.displayText: It's filling up... what is this progress bar...

spans.text: It's filling up... what is this progress bar...

units.rawText: It shows the progress of universal entropization, or in other words, how much of the sector's mass has been depleted. The sector can only be restarted once the progress bar reaches 100% and the entire universe reaches complete thermodynamic equilibrium.
units.displayText: It shows the progress of universal entropization, or in other words, how much of the sector's mass has been depleted. The sector can only be restarted once the progress bar reaches 100% and the entire universe reaches complete thermodynamic equilibrium.

spans.text: It shows the progress of universal entropization, or in other words, how much of the sector's mass has been depleted. The sector can only be restarted once the progress bar reaches 100% and the entire universe reaches complete thermodynamic equilibrium.

units.rawText: So we need to clear out all the mass in the universe?
units.displayText: So we need to clear out all the mass in the universe?

spans.text: So we need to clear out all the mass in the universe?

units.rawText: Yes. The humans instituted this as a condition for the universal reset to simulate a complete Heat Death.
units.displayText: Yes. The humans instituted this as a condition for the universal reset to simulate a complete Heat Death.

spans.text: Yes. The humans instituted this as a condition for the universal reset to simulate a complete Heat Death.

units.rawText: In other words, everything that used to be the Jiutian sector needs to become Heat Death Entropics...
units.displayText: In other words, everything that used to be the Jiutian sector needs to become Heat Death Entropics...

spans.text: In other words, everything that used to be the Jiutian sector needs to become Heat Death Entropics...

units.rawText: But what about the data? What about the last hope they left behind for us?
units.displayText: But what about the data? What about the last hope they left behind for us?

spans.text: But what about the data? What about the last hope they left behind for us?

units.rawText: My guess is... the data Belka and the others left us counts towards the mass that needs to be wiped out, too.
units.displayText: My guess is... the data Belka and the others left us counts towards the mass that needs to be wiped out, too.

spans.text: My guess is... the data Belka and the others left us counts towards the mass that needs to be wiped out, too.

units.rawText: But how... is there really no other way? Can't we preserve ANYTHING?
units.displayText: But how... is there really no other way? Can't we preserve ANYTHING?

spans.text: But how... is there really no other way? Can't we preserve ANYTHING?

units.rawText: ...No, we're keeping this data. Like Gagarin and the others said, we'll be taking it with us.
units.displayText: ...No, we're keeping this data. Like Gagarin and the others said, we'll be taking it with us.

spans.text: ...No, we're keeping this data. Like Gagarin and the others said, we'll be taking it with us.

units.rawText: I have a plan, Fresnel. But I need your help.
units.displayText: I have a plan, Fresnel. But I need your help.

spans.text: I have a plan, Fresnel. But I need your help.

units.rawText: Whew... good thing you aren't badly hurt...
units.displayText: Whew... good thing you aren't badly hurt...

spans.text: Whew... good thing you aren't badly hurt...
